=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:line 6-8 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The VERSION_TAG regex rejects valid SemVer 2.0 tags with pre-release identifiers or build metadata.
  WHY: Both reviewers identified that `^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$` only accepts strict `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` tags, and one noted this blocks pre-release/recovery tagging.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:lines 17,23,28,30,44,67,89 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Every git remote operation hardcodes the "origin" remote name.
  WHY: Both reviewers observed the script assumes `origin` for all remote interactions, which breaks on clones where the canonical remote has a different name.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:line 35 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The error path for `git ls-remote` may not include enough diagnostic detail for auth or network failures.
  WHY: The reviewer reported that stderr is not captured separately, so failure messages can be less actionable.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:line 76-78 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The partial-publish recovery fetch can leave local refs updated inconsistently if the second ref fetch fails.
  WHY: The reviewer warned that fetching the tag and `stable` in one command may update one ref before the other fails.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:line 87 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Exiting with `${TAG_LSREMOTE_RC}` in the non-0/non-2 path may not propagate the failure cleanly in all shell contexts.
  WHY: The reviewer flagged the exit-code handling as potentially unreliable for some network-failure cases.
- tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py:line 1-204 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The custom test runner stops at the first failure instead of aggregating multiple failures.
  WHY: The reviewer noted the file uses a `main()`-driven runner rather than pytest, so later failures are not reported in the same run.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:10 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The VERSION_TAG regex only matches strict SemVer format without pre-release or build metadata.
  WHY: Tags like `v1.2.3-rc.1` or `v1.0.0+build.42` are rejected by the pattern.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:All git fetch/push/ls-remote calls | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The script hardcodes `origin` for every remote operation.
  WHY: Clones that use a different remote name, such as `upstream`, will fail when the script tries to use `origin`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:Line 35 — LSREMOTE_OUT variable and error message construction | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `git ls-remote` failure path may produce less actionable diagnostics because stderr is not captured separately.
  WHY: Auth or network errors can be harder to debug when the script only includes captured stdout in its error message.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:Line 76–78 — partial-publish recovery fetch | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Fetching the tag and `stable` together can leave local refs partially updated if the second ref fetch fails.
  WHY: A partial fetch could create an inconsistent local state before conflict detection runs.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:Line 87 — exit code in elif branch | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Exiting with `${TAG_LSREMOTE_RC}` may not propagate failure cleanly in all shell contexts.
  WHY: Non-zero network-failure codes could be handled inconsistently despite `set -e`.
- tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py:Line 1–204 — Entire test file | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The custom `main()` test runner stops at the first exception instead of aggregating failures.
  WHY: Multiple test failures would surface sequentially, increasing debugging time.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:Code: All git remote operations (lines 17,23,28,30,44,67,89): git ls-remote origin ..., git fetch origin ..., git push origin ... | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Every git remote operation hardcodes the "origin" remote name.
  WHY: The script aborts on clones where the default remote is renamed or absent, even if the repository otherwise has the expected refs.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:Code: Line 6-8: if [[ ! "${VERSION_TAG}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then ... exit 2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex rejects valid SemVer tags with pre-release identifiers or build metadata.
  WHY: Operators cannot use the script for pre-release tagging, which forces workarounds outside the script.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
